# soapysdr-module-remote

**The client half of SoapyRemote — uses an SDR served by another machine**

- **Version recorded:** 0.5.2
- **Categories:** `sdr-hardware`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/pothosware/SoapyRemote/wiki>

## What it does

Discovers SDRs published on the network by `soapyremote-server` and presents them locally as SoapySDR devices. The application sees an ordinary radio; the samples arrive over the network.

## Why you would want it

This is the half that goes on the machine with the screen. Install `soapyremote-server` where the dongle is and this where you are sitting, and every SoapySDR program reaches the remote radio unchanged. Getting the antenna away from a noisy house is the usual reason.

## Before it will work

A running `soapyremote-server` somewhere reachable. Discovery uses broadcast, so a device on another subnet must be named explicitly in the device string rather than found.

## Install and launch

- **Installed with the profile:** [`sdr`](../profiles/sdr.md).
- **Install:** `hammunition install soapysdr-module-remote --dry-run`, read the plan, then run it without `--dry-run`.
- **Launch:** Its package ships its own commands and application-menu entry; a unit that ships none gets a generated terminal entry (**D-050**). `hammunition status` lists what is installed.
- **The install needs the network to:** your distribution's package archive.

## Offline use

*Not yet documented for this application.* Read “Before it will work” above for what it needs; the install-time network line above is the only offline fact generated from the manifest. Internet, a local network and a radio link are three different things, and this page does not claim any of them works until it says so.

## How it installs

- apt: `soapysdr-module-remote`

## Known problems

Network bandwidth bounds the sample rate, and exceeding it drops samples rather than reporting an error -- the symptom is gaps and clicks that look like a hardware fault. There is no authentication anywhere in this protocol, in either half.
